pathscan.why: Adopted from atelier's PS4 (ruled 2026-07-28): the gateable surface is the live documents, with the RECORD stores named out. A record describes the tree as it stood when it was written and has no time axis, so it can never come clean without markers that would falsify it — docs/SESSIONS.md carries five references to paths that were true on the day. Forced here on 2026-08-17 when retiring the tools/board.py shim turned four honest session-log mentions of it into permanent findings. Cover given up: a stale path inside a record is not flagged, which is the intended trade.
